title: O Lord! Whose Forming Hand One Blood
description: O Lord! Whose Forming Hand One Blood in Tonic Solfa to MELCOMBE, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 800 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Prayer for Zeal and Love”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to MELCOMBE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O Lord! whose form-ing hand one blood To all the tribes and na-tions gave, And giv'st to all their dail-y food, Look down in pi-ty on the slave!

lines: O Lord! whose forming hand one blood
To all the tribes and nations gave,
And giv'st to all their daily food,
Look down in pity on the slave!
Fetters and chains and stripes remove,
And pour the tide of light and love
Upon their souls, and bid them live.
Oh! kindle in our hearts a flame
Of zeal, thy holy will to do;
And bid each one, who loves thy name,
Love all his bleeding brethren too.
Through all thy temples, let the stain
And, hand in hand, let Afric's train,
